name: vscode-worktree-shell-start
description: Run a shell hook after Git creates a new worktree, with the repository/worktree paths exported as environment variables.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The hook runs shell commands from configuration, so it is skipped in untrusted workspaces unless `worktreeShellStart.runInUntrustedWorkspaces` is enabled in user settings.

script.description: Operations to run. Overrides the worktreeShellStart.script setting for this task.

shell.description: Shell used to run the operations. Overrides the worktreeShellStart.shell setting.

args.description: Arguments passed to the operations. Overrides the worktreeShellStart.args setting.

worktreeShellStart.enabled.markdownDescription: Run the worktree hook when Git creates a new worktree.

worktreeShellStart.script.markdownDescription:
Shell operations to run after a new worktree is created. No shebang needed: the value is written to a temporary script and executed with `#worktreeShellStart.shell#`.

Available environment variables: `VSCODE_REPOSITORY_DIR` (main checkout), `VSCODE_WORKTREE_DIR`, `VSCODE_WORKTREE_NAME`, `VSCODE_WORKTREE_BRANCH`, `VSCODE_WORKTREE_REF`, `VSCODE_GIT_COMMON_DIR`.

Example:
```sh
cp "$VSCODE_REPOSITORY_DIR/.env" "$VSCODE_WORKTREE_DIR/.env"
```

Leave empty to disable. Commands run without `set -e`; add it yourself to stop at the first failure.

worktreeShellStart.shell.markdownDescription: Shell used to execute `#worktreeShellStart.script#`. Falls back to `sh` when the shell is not found in `PATH`.

worktreeShellStart.args.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the operations, available as `$1`, `$2`, ... inside the script.

worktreeShellStart.runInUntrustedWorkspa.markdownDescription: Run the hook even when the workspace is not trusted. Only the value from **user** settings is honored; a workspace setting cannot enable this for itself.
